title: Apply the bulk discount per line
issue: Order totals must apply the 10% bulk discount to each line whose own quantity is 10 or more. The discount is never applied to the order as a whole: two lines of six units do not qualify, even though the order contains twelve units. Totals are whole cents and `orderTotal` must reject a line with a negative or fractional quantity or unit price.
expectedBehavior: orderTotal discounts a line by 10% when that line's quantity is 10 or more and leaves every other line at full price, so an order of two six-unit lines is not discounted at all.
